description.fun: A fish head stuck on a dinosaur's tail end. Its mighty legs could run at over 60 km/h and its jaws made it the top predator of its time, but it can't breathe unless it's underwater. Putting the head at the tail may echo the first, famously backwards reconstruction of Elasmosaurus.
description.guide: A Water and Dragon-type Fossil Pokémon from Pokémon Sword and Shield, restored from the Fossilized Fish and the Fossilized Drake. Its Pokédex says it hunted its prey to extinction.
description.tagline: A fish head on a dinosaur tail, and a fearsome hunter
